summary: The root كين (kyn) is related to the root سكن (skn), meaning to be still or quiet. It also connects to كون (kwn), which implies existence or being.
lane: 10 اِسْتَكَانَ ذ : see اِسْتَكَنَ in art. سكن : and see art. كون .
